jobs.prompt:
Deep Oracle research — batch 0. Run: python3 /home/josh434/.autognosia/scripts/pick_next_wiki_topic.py

jobs.name: Oracle Index Update
jobs.prompt: Run Oracle index update: execute the oracle_index_update.py script from the autognosia repository. This script incrementally updates the Oracle search index by detecting modified wiki files since the last run, running graphify extract in incremental mode (never --force), and merging new chunks into the existing graph. Unlike a full rebuild (which takes ~24h), this incremental update only processes changed files and should complete in minutes. Appends to the existing graph rather than rebuilding from scratch. Log results to oracle/brain/rebuild-log.md.

Deliver the question directly to the user via the configured messaging service.

jobs.name: Weekly Review
jobs.prompt: Generate weekly review: summarize completed tasks, project progress, wiki changes, research completed, decisions made, upcoming deadlines, subscription renewals. Deliver to user. Use the organizer-state and wiki-maintenance skills.

jobs.name: Session Audit
jobs.prompt: Review the last 7 days of session history for missed knowledge: identify user decisions not saved to wiki, preferences not recorded, troubleshooting results worth preserving, and sessions with unresolved issues. Generate a concise report with specific recommendations. Use the wiki-ingestion and wiki-maintenance skills.

jobs.name: Persona Audit
jobs.prompt: Run monthly persona audit: read current stored preferences and user model, scan recent sessions for corrections and preference shifts, compare stored preferences against actual user behavior, check for stale or contradicted preferences. Report persona drift with evidence citations and recommend updates. Use the wiki-maintenance skill.

jobs.name: Workflow Suggestion
jobs.prompt: Conduct monthly workflow audit: scan past month sessions for repetitive patterns (repeated searches, recurring manual file operations, repeated status checks, questions asked more than once, manually compiled reports). Propose 3-5 concrete automations. Use the wiki-maintenance and organizer-state skills.
